subject: 61 FR 25228 (1996-05-20) Docket 96N-0151 - withdrawal of NDA 18-103 Selacryn (ticrynafen) Tablets
finding_summary: Federal Register Volume 61, Number 98 (Monday, May 20, 1996), pages 25228-25229, FR Doc 96-12570. FDA withdraws approval of NDA 18-103 for Selacryn (ticrynafen) Tablets held by SmithKline Beecham Pharmaceuticals. SmithKline requested withdrawal because the product is no longer being marketed and waived its opportunity for a hearing. Supplementary information: by letter dated June 30, 1994, SmithKline requested that FDA withdraw NDA 18-103, stating that the company discontinued marketing the product in 1980 because of liver toxicity observed after approval of the NDA. Effective date May 20, 1996. The notice does NOT state the original approval date, class, or review priority.
project_effect: names NDA 18-103 Selacryn (ticrynafen) as a 1979 gap candidate; does not supply an ORIG date/class/priority, so the candidate is recorded as NAMED_CANDIDATE_NOT_ADDED and is never written to pre1980_fda_decisions.csv
